answer: Renewal is paid in proven uptime, not cash. Each identity must re-certify every epoch by committing measured hardware hours into a live exam keyed to that epoch; the meters bind to hardware keys, so uptime cannot be borrowed, pooled, or pre-aged, and a fresh grove of shells must each grow its own hours from zero. Privileges unlock only above a recorded hours threshold, so n clones need n full clocks of real machines wandering the same capacity, and every wharf they queue at meters one hull at a time. A reset identity starts the clock over; nothing carries across.
